events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, hundreds of thousands gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. What's your favourite memory or track from the iconic festival?

events.title: Tribute to Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, at his Graceland home.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in '77. His voice, his moves, his legacy – forever etched in music history. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur shooting anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, hip-hop lost one of its most powerful voices. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his enduring impact on music and culture. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon on this day in 1970. His guitar changed the world. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on this day in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite song from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and attitude have fronted The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your top Liam tune?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' in the UK on this day in 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago today, John Lennon released his profound 'Imagine' album in the UK. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Anniversary of the first iPod announcement
events.blurb: Apple first unveiled the revolutionary iPod, which would transform how we listen to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple introduced the original iPod and changed music consumption forever. Remember your first one? How many songs did it hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No', the first film in the iconic 007 series.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond, and which theme tune is the ultimate?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a legendary solo artist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy of peace and iconic songs live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many unforgettable laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your favourite track from the double LP?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost one of music's most electrifying performers, Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day 35 years ago. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
